dressCode: Jacket required for men; a tie isn't needed. There's no set rule for women, but the restaurant is quite formal.
children: Children are welcome as long as they're supervised at all times. There's no children's menu, but the kitchen will make simple dishes on request.
bookingOpens: Online about 4–5 months ahead, with further dates opened at the start of each month. The restaurant suggests booking a few weeks ahead; window tables go first.
bookingPhone: +39 06 3509 2152 (reservations office, Monday to Friday 10:30am–6:30pm Rome time)
cancellation: A credit card guarantees the booking. Changes or cancellations less than 72 hours ahead are charged.
groups: Tables of 4 or more choose one of the tasting menus. Groups of 6 to 16 book by email (ROMHI.LaPergolaReservations@waldorfastoria.com); 10 to 16 have the restaurant's private area.
